title: 建築デザイン総合演習A
subtitle: Architectural Integrated Exercises for Design A
educationalGoal: This course is an exercise course that comprehensively utilizes the basic knowledge of architecture that has been acquired so far. Students will practice safe, beautiful and comfortable architecture and urban space through exercises. Understand the relationship with architectural conditions by developing architectural design II and working on facility design and urban design with more complex contents. Conditions include program, plan, structure, environment, city, etc.
advice: This subject is a design practice subject that develops the contents of architectural design I and II. The class management includes lectures on architectural planning, architectural planning, structure, environment, and urban space in accordance with each design issue, and esquisses on design proposals. Esquisse performs program analysis, urban space analysis, functional configuration, spatial configuration, floor plan, cross section plan, elevation plan, and urban design. In Eesques, students and teachers face each other. The following four themes are planned as specific design and planning issues. Select two of them and create a design / plan work. 1. Library design 2. Apartment design 3. Urban analysis and design 4. Architecture Planning Program (Refine Architecture) At the review meeting, the submitted works will be reviewed and presented as well as excellent works.
requiredKnowledge: This course is based on basic knowledge of architecture in general and the design ability of architectural design I and II. Students try to apply the knowledge related to the planning and design of architecture and exterior space learned in various classes to the design work.

activityGoals.body: Students can understand the purpose of the assignment and express it as an architectural / urban space.
Students can replace the program content as software in the assignment with architectural space.
Students can develop their ability to organize and design various spaces as architecture and urban space.
Students can analyze the characteristics of the local culture and community and reflect them in the design.
Students can create and express drawings, models, photographs, and texts as works.

achievementLevels.ideal: The designed works functionally fully satisfy the design requirements, and good architectural plans and urban spaces are established. In addition, attractive architecture and urban spaces have been created, and unique designs have been proposed. The drawing expression is an advanced and beautiful presentation.
achievementLevels.standard: The designed works functionally satisfy the design requirements, and good architectural plans and urban spaces are established. Also, they are accurately drawn as design drawings.
